title: Grills by Demant
about: Grills by Demant is a family-run fabrication shop in Atlanta, Georgia, owned by Chris and Ann Demant. Chris spent more than a decade working with stainless steel in Denmark before the couple moved to the United States in 2015, where they first opened a custom furniture shop. Grilling became the niche that brought his skills together: today Chris runs the shop floor, research and production, and Ann leads the office.

They build solid-fuel equipment for restaurant kitchens by hand: Argentinian-style platform grills and Japanese-style robata grills in stainless steel lined with refractory fire brick, from 36 inches to more than ten feet wide, along with ovens, offset smokers, rotisseries and grill towers that raise and lower the grates over the fire. Every grill is a collaboration between their stainless-steel expertise and the client’s own ideas, and their hearths cook in restaurants such as Shiso in Miami.
